name: hairpin-of-transience-banish-three-wither-counters
notes: Same [Class Bonus] champion patch as frostlorn-caress-four-wither-counters (starting champion CardID-patched to Diao Chan, Enchantress with Subcards patched to keep Spirit of Water in the lineage, so WATER stays unlocked -- Hairpin's own element is WATER). This satisfies activateAbilityPrereqs["xl3tzqhlt1:0"]'s IsClassBonusActive(["CLERIC"]) check (GeneratedMacroCode.php ~7386). Hairpin of Transience is seeded directly onto the field (it's a REGALIA/ITEM activated from the field, not cast from hand). Activating it (mode 10001 CustomInput Activate:0) first pays its cost -- ActivatedAbilityCost's "banish self" case for xl3tzqhlt1 (Custom/GameLogic.php ~6316) immediately moves it to myBanish, BEFORE the target is even chosen -- then activateAbilityAbilities["xl3tzqhlt1:0"] (~7368) offers an MZCHOOSE of every non-champion object on either field (only the opponent's seeded Dungeon Guide qualifies); customDQHandlers["xl3tzqhlt1:0:ActivateAbility-1"] (~29015) calls AddCounters($player, $chosen, "wither", 3) on the chosen target. Both halves of the printed clause are asserted as semantic: the target receives exactly 3 wither counters, AND Hairpin of Transience itself ends up in the banishment zone (not the graveyard/discard), confirming "Banish Hairpin of Transience" is a real banish, not merely a destroy.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Banish Hairpin of Transience: Put three wither counters on target non-champion object.
